findings.description: enable_key_rotation is not set, so it defaults to false and the same key material protects the logs bucket indefinitely. This extends the exposure window and blast radius if the key material is ever compromised, and fails common compliance baselines for keys protecting log data.

No policy argument is supplied, so AWS applies the default key policy granting the account root principal full kms:* access and delegating all key permissions to IAM. For a key protecting log data this provides no least-privilege restriction on which principals may decrypt, disable, or schedule deletion of the key.
